## Preamble

The purpose of this script is to convert the available `.gaf` file for our organism into a table suitable for use with `topGO`.

## 1. Load Libraries

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
```

## 2. Load .gaf file (raw GO terms table) + Basic Data Cleaning

```{r}
# Load data
go_tbl_raw <- read_tsv("../data/GO_enrichment/GO_terms/GCF_017639785.1_BCM_Maur_2.0_gene_ontology.gaf", skip = 8)

# Select only relevant columns
go_tbl_clean <- select(go_tbl_raw, GeneID, Symbol,
                       Qualifier, GO_ID, Reference, Aspect, Gene_Name)

# Save intermediary table (may be useful to see references for certain annotations)
write_tsv(go_tbl_clean, "../data/GO_enrichment/GO_terms/go_terms_cleaned.tsv")
```

## 3. Generate & Save Table Suitable for use in GO Enrichment

```{r}
# Generate Table
topGO_tbl <- go_tbl_clean %>%
  group_by(Symbol) %>%
  summarize(GO_IDs = paste(GO_ID, collapse = ", "))

# Save Table
write_tsv(topGO_tbl, "../data/GO_enrichment/GO_terms/mesaur_GOIDs.tsv", col_names = FALSE)
```
